prevention_rule: Every concrete planned change goes through the existing canonical delivery preflight with an explicit action; match 34 active PROVEN lessons before execution and fail closed for unacknowledged risks.

historical: Original preflight loaded PROVEN lessons but did not call planned-action-guard; PR 5490 15 GitHub rules were missing action triggers.
current: Source candidate has 34 action triggers in one registry and invokes the existing matcher from loadDeliveryPreflight when --action/plannedAction is supplied; exact-head CI and production use not yet proven.

fix: Add 15 GitHub triggers, reuse matchPlannedAction in loadDeliveryPreflight, accept explicit plannedAction and acknowledgedPreventionRules, extend existing regression tests and AGENTS.md.
